messages.subject: TTCL | EPC, power and cross-border stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear TTCL Leadership Team,

TTCL's EPC and power activities across Thailand and international markets align closely with my experience in regulated industrial operations, energy transition and country-facing stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes governance and external engagement around a large solar and battery-storage program, carbon-data readiness and multi-agency operating approvals. I am used to coordinating technical, corporate and public-sector stakeholders around complex delivery requirements.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country/project leadership. I have attached a TTCL-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
